description: Na₃BN₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four N³⁻ atoms to form corner-sharing NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.45 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N³⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.75 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N³⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.61 Å. B³⁺ is bonded in a linear geometry to two N³⁻ atoms. Both B-N bond lengths are 1.35 Å. There are two inequivalent N³⁻ sites. In the first N³⁻ site, N³⁻ is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to six Na¹⁺ and one B³⁺ atom. In the second N³⁻ site, N³⁻ is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to six Na¹⁺ and one B³⁺ atom.
